connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Feed: 50 ohm line (w 3.92 mm, y -13 -> -9.711, length 3.289 mm) + lambda/4 transformer (w 0.80 mm, l 6.60 mm, y -9.711 -> -3.111) touching the radiating edge y=-3.111 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)
feed.transformer_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen static Z0 (Wheeler 35 um correction): w 0.80 mm -> Zt 102.5 ohm; Kirschning-Jansen eps_eff(f0) 3.197 (GUIDE_MODEL)

parasitic_params.note: Parasitic unchanged with respect to US3_PS4_2 (Wp 10.0 mm, Lp 7.46 mm, y -2.98...4.48, z 1.035). Only patch_L changes (6.302 -> 6.222 mm), so the patch edge moves to y=-3.111 and the plan-view y clearance sheet-to-transformer end shrinks from 0.171 to 0.131 mm (different layers, z offset 1.035 mm); the +y overhang grows from 1.329 to 1.369 mm.

US3_PS4_2.note: single design change: driven patch length -0.08 mm. Parasitic (Wp 10.0, Lp 7.46, z 1.035), U-slot (absolute), transformer 0.80 x 6.60, material, board and port unchanged. Mesh hints as US3_PS4_2 (mesh only) unless stated in mesh_hint_note.

rationale: Owner request 2026-11-16: test Wp 10 mm with a slightly shorter patch_L to move the S11 pair up a few MHz. Reference US3_PS4_2 (round 042, base mesh): minima 7.868 / 8.098 GHz, worst S11 -8.56 dB at 8.2368 GHz, lower channel edge -13.35 dB, eta minimum 0.30 at 8.087 GHz. Goal: improve the upper edge without losing the lower one. GUIDE_MODEL, not an EM result: with patch_L alone -0.10 mm the US3_PS4 model gave about +45 / +26 MHz (lower / upper minimum); scaled to -0.08 mm about +36 / +21 MHz (guide uncertainty at least +-10 MHz: the slope came from a different Wp and mesh, the two modes shift by different amounts and the coupling k changes with patch_L). It is not assumed that the eta valley moves out of the channel. GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11, efficiency or gain is claimed.

pre_registered_hypothesis.H0: S11 minima in 7.88-7.92 GHz (lower; 042: 7.868, guide +36 MHz -> about 7.904) and 8.10-8.14 GHz (upper; 042: 8.098, guide +21 MHz -> about 8.119); pair still resolved (two minima).
pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Worst S11 in the channel (1 MHz grid, 501 samples) <= -10 dB (042: -8.56 dB at 8.2368 GHz; guide: shifting the 042 curve up 20-35 MHz would improve the upper edge but not necessarily reach -10 dB). Not claimed.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: eta >= 0.55 and realized broadside gain >= 2 dBi at the 11 NF2FF points (042: eta minimum 0.30 at 8.087 GHz; expected to FAIL while the upper dark mode stays inside the channel).
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: H1 true and eta minimum above 0.30 -> candidate refinement of US3_PS4_2 (fine mesh and HFSS are owner decisions). H1 false but the worst edge improves versus -8.56 dB -> report the sensitivity and decide with the owner whether to continue the patch_L sweep. If the lower edge worsens clearly (below -10 dB at 7.7376 GHz) or the minima shift by more than 40 MHz, report and recalibrate the slope before any further change.

manufacturability.layers: 3 copper layers (L1 patch + feed + U-slot at z=h, L2 floating parasitic at z=1.035 mm, L3 ground at z=0) and 2 dielectric layers of ~1.035 mm each: standard 3-copper-layer FR4 multilayer. Stack-up unchanged by this variant (z_par and h1/h2 NOT modified).
manufacturability.vias: none: floating parasitic, planar microstrip feed.
manufacturability.min_feature_mm: U-slot arms 0.8 mm (unchanged); the parasitic is a solid rectangle 10.0 x 7.46 mm, no feature < 0.8 mm. Smallest planar gap: 0.131 mm in y between the transformer end and the sheet edge (different layers, z offset 1.035 mm; was 0.171 mm), comparable to the layer-to-layer registration tolerance. The narrower sheet leaves more FR4 copper-free around it on the inner layer (ask the fabricator about dummy-fill / balancing rules; any fill must stay several mm away from the sheet and the patch).
manufacturability.stackup_note: As US3_PS4: the model assumes ONE homogeneous eps_r 4.4 over 2.07 mm; the fabricator must give the real stack-up. z_par is not changed, so no new dependency on the stack-up is introduced.
manufacturability.tolerances_to_specify: inner-layer etching of Wp (+-0.05 mm of 10.0 mm) and layer-to-layer registration in x and y (a +-0.1 mm offset is much smaller than the 0.711 mm x clearance to the patch edge, but of the order of the 0.131 mm y clearance, a plan-view distance between different layers). patch_L etching: the guide sensitivity (~7-10 MHz per 0.01 mm) is comparable to the intended -0.08 mm change, so an etching error of +-0.02 mm moves the pair by about +-15-20 MHz.
manufacturability.risks: The k(Wp) law is a guide and may under- or over-predict; the sheet is buried and cannot be inspected or tuned after lamination; homogeneous FR4 model is provisional; the dark upper mode is poorly radiating and dissipates in the FR4, so the improvement in S11, if any, is by loss. Additional risk of this variant: the intended shift (about 20-35 MHz) is of the same order as the guide uncertainty and the fabrication tolerance; mesh differences between the 042 base mesh and this variant (patch edge y changes by 0.04 mm) can masquerade as a design effect.

purpose: Shift the S11 pair of US3_PS4_2 (Wp 10 mm) a few MHz upward by shortening the driven patch only (patch_L 6.302 -> 6.222 mm); openEMS base + fine mesh, same command as 042.
mesh_hint_note: MESH ONLY, no geometry effect. Base US3_PS4_2 used y [-0.215, -2.99]. With patch_L 6.222 (patch edge -3.111) the fine mesh fails the 1.5 grading limit with that hint (ratio 2.07 between the patch-edge rule lines and -2.99) and no single hint passes base and fine (prepare-only search 2026-11-16, step 0.005 mm over -3.10...-2.93). Hints y [-0.215, -3.07, -3.03, -2.97] pass base and fine; the set was chosen in the middle of a passing region (a in -3.08...-3.065, b in -3.04...-3.02, c in -2.97...-2.96 all pass), so it is not a knife-edge. Mesh differs from the 042 base mesh (-2.99 hint removed, three lines added between patch edge and parasitic edge): a mesh effect cannot be separated from the patch_L effect in a base-vs-042 comparison.
